name: Thorvald_Glaive
description: House Thorvald Elite glaive: the Landsraad halberd's shaft (shortened), collar ring, socket and butt cap with a hand-modelled curved glaive blade and back hook, a rust cloth grip wrap; brass -> copper, shaft black, dark steel blade with a honed edge. No energy effects.
rebuild: blender -b --python make_glaive.py ; python paint_glaive.py ; blender -b --python make_glaive.py -- --shots
notes: Weapon space = Gurney's javelin (GurneySet_Javelin): head at -z, hand at the origin, blade in the xz plane. Vanilla prefab: javelin rotationX -90 rotationY 90 on ...B_rWristJ.B_Weapon; in Blender (bone_local) that is rotation (0, 90, 0), checked in the Gurney clips. Anim set: Gurney.
